caption: The drawing depicts three rectangular objects, each rendered in a reddish-orange color and positioned against a beige background. The top right rectangle displays a complex, interwoven circular design of holes set inside a rectangular border pattern. The bottom left rectangle has a large central circle filled with a swirling pattern of holes, with additional groups of holes in the corners and along the border.
